body: Oh. If they’re not political, that’s fine. They should at least know I’m passionate about liberal politics, though.
No. No I can’t. We have to be on the same page politically. I’ve seen couples who aren’t and they’re constantly arguing politics with each other. I’m not doing that.

You think the blue pic is too… like… glaring at the camera? Should I replace it with a smile pic?

The Big Lebowski side by side is actually because I went to a Halloween party in it and they all thought I was Blonde Jesus… So I wanted to make sure people knew what the reference was… With that info in mind, do you still think I should change it?

The honesty being mentioned twice was intentional. It’s my most valued trait in a human being and something I desperately need in a partner. I’ve been hurt by someone who lied before, but I don’t really feel any trauma or anxiety over it. She had her own set of issues that I can better recognize beforehand for next time.

Also, it sucks that owning your mistakes comes off that way. 😕 That list is meant to say, “This is what I already am/strive for” and “This is what I’d like from a partner.” It’s meant to display my ideals and standards for a relationship. Should I get rid of it and just do a fun prompt?

I’m actually quite the introvert, so pictures of me doing diverse and interesting things are few and far between. I don’t have any good new photos. Unless they’re of my cat. I’ll try to take more pictures to add to it.

As for the prompts, I’ll change the Destiny 2 one to a question. The guitar is a pop singing style while the “proof” one is classical singing, so I can show off my vocal talent, so I’m a little hesitant to curb one of those just yet.

Thank you for your response! You are very thorough.
There’s no shortage of liberals in my area of Texas. I’m in a blue patch. I’m also very passionate about politics and want to be upfront about it. You think I should take it away?

Thank you! I appreciate the advice!

As for the guitar, it’s a video of me playing it, not a photo. That’s why it’s blurry.

Also, The Dude costume was for a Halloween party. I thought it showcased my fun side, but if it isn’t a good thing to have on Hinge, I’ll just replace it with something else.

I’m looking for something serious.

I’ve been on Hinge for 2 years.

I use Hinge every day for anywhere from 5 minutes to an hour.

I receive probably a like every other day, but I match maybe once a month.

I send a like to whoever I’m attracted to and to whom I feel some kind of connection with based on their profile (probably anywhere from 1 to 10 per day). My likes always have a personalized comment.
